provenance.sem_note: Standard errors are the per-observable values the scoring wrote out, propagated in quadrature under the chosen weights. They are per-observable, so they no longer share one value the way the hand-transcribed baseline did.

metrics.label: RDF
metrics.detail: Radial distribution functions among the liquid atoms, evaluated in bulk water and in interfacial water and averaged over the O-O, O-H and H-H species pairs.

metrics.label: VDOS
metrics.detail: Vibrational density of states, evaluated in bulk water and in interfacial water.

metrics.label: Density
metrics.detail: Density profiles of the liquid at the interface, including the wetting proxy rho2/rho1.

metrics.label: Orientation
metrics.detail: Orientational profiles of the liquid as a function of distance from the surface, compared out to 11 Å from the sheet, with every bin weighted by the water population N(z) sitting in it, so the sparse regions cannot outvote the water that is actually there.

metrics.label: VSFG
metrics.detail: VSFG spectra for the graphene-water and air-water interfaces, scored on the hydrogen-bonded and dangling O-H peak positions, their intensity ratio and the width of the hydrogen-bonded band.

metrics.label: Friction
metrics.detail: Solid-liquid friction, scored on the plateau value of the friction coefficient and on the full Green-Kubo running integral.
